chain.text: Tankers keep getting hit near Hormuz; crude stays above $100
Costly oil imports drag the rupee to 96.71 per dollar
RBI starts selling dollars straight to IOC, HPCL and BPCL
Wholesale fuel and power prices jump 26% in a year
Prices hit a 23-month high; RBI hikes to 5.50%, so loans cost more

title: gulf oil → your loan EMI
why: India buys most of its oil abroad in dollars. When the Gulf flares up, that cost travels through the rupee into prices and loan EMIs.
